ux_dom.plugins.csp.doc: CSP nonces — **one place, least confusion: middleware**.

Csp.doc: **The** CSP plugin — installs middleware. One line, no other wiring.

auto.doc: Pick dev vs prod from DEBUG (env or argument) — zero-choice DX.

dev.doc: Create-app / local DX: CDNs + style unsafe-inline.

prod.doc: Production: no CDN hosts, no script unsafe-inline, no bare ws:/wss:.
